notes: Your own place. In 🧰 Tools → 🏠 Home, set where you live (or tap Here). Decorate it there or in the story; anything you buy, hang or set up gets added. First-time visitors look around and react in character, regulars notice what's new, and a few neighbors live nearby: a sound through the wall now and then, a hallway run-in. It shows who's been over, and Home is at the top of the Move list.
